description: LANSING, Mich., October 19, 2023 — State Rep. Betsy Coffia (D-Traverse City) celebrated the unanimous passage of her bill, House Bill 4516, by the Michigan Senate. HB 4516, once enacted, will formally expand state domestic violence resources to Tribal service providers.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY COMMITTEE TO ELECT BETSY COFFIA P
title: Coffia Bill Supporting Tribal Domestic Violence Shelters Passes Full Senate Unanimously | Betsy Coffia
